question: Do frozen December cluster labels improve retrieval of five cross-region analogues for descriptive reconstruction of the held-out 2024 organization salary field?

admission.join: Exact supplier ID; same ID and CSV/NPZ order; verify reference-year numbers and municipality names/types from core_ID_context.csv.
admission.numeric_required: Observed December spending and finite frozen X; positive Total and organization salary; positive population; nonnegative market_access and workers/residents; education share in [0,1].
admission.missing_or_invalid: Exclude from query and candidate universe with explicit field reasons; never zero-impute. Target validity participates only in admission, never target values in ranking. No assumption that all 1445 pass.
admission.type_equivalence: Exact literal supplier_type; no mixing of municipal districts, urban districts or intracity territories.
admission.candidate_rule: Admitted territory, same supplier_type and supplier_region different from query; query necessarily excluded.

methods.total: Five nearest by abs(log reported December Total_j - log Total_i).
methods.spending: Five nearest by Euclidean distance in published frozen six-dimensional X; kernels.embed and saved reference.json, no refit of scales.
methods.context_no_salary: Five nearest by Euclidean distance in four coordinates: log population, log1p market_access, log1p workers/residents, arcsin sqrt education share. Divide each coordinate difference by its IQR among this query's eligible candidates, using NumPy linear quantiles. Equal coordinate weights; no salary coordinate or context6 label.
methods.NCut_hard: Five nearest by frozen X among eligible candidates with identical frozen NCut10 December group. Unavailable if fewer than five; no fallback.
methods.SSE_hard: Same hard rule using SSE10 labels.
methods.NCut_soft: Take up to three nearest same-NCut-group eligible candidates by X, then fill to five with nearest remaining eligible candidates by X, regardless of group. Candidates cannot repeat.
methods.SSE_soft: Same soft rule using SSE10 labels.
methods.median: Median log salary of all eligible candidates, requiring at least five; no retrieved five and no salary-based selection.

numerics.context_zero_IQR: If any of four candidate IQRs is zero or nonfinite, context_no_salary is unavailable; do not remove feature or add epsilon. Other methods remain available.
numerics.ties: Ascending distance, then ascending numeric supplier ID; no rounding before sorting.
numerics.prediction_retrieval: Arithmetic mean of log salaries of exactly five selected candidates.
numerics.prediction_median: Median of log salaries of all same-type other-region eligible candidates.
numerics.target: log positive 2024 organization salary; observed annual field, not future-time outcome

evaluation.primary_support: Intersection of queries for which every one of eight methods is available, fixed by availability only, not error.
evaluation.primary_error: Mean absolute log salary error within each query region, then unweighted mean over represented regions; each region equal weight.
secondary_errors: Equal-region MAE in RUB using exp(log prediction)
Equal-query pooled MAE log and RUB, explicitly secondary
evaluation.coverage: Per method query and region counts out of admitted universe; reason for unavailable; shared primary support and counts by region and supplier_type.
evaluation.support_sensitivity: Also evaluate six non-hard methods on their common support (total, spending, context_no_salary, NCut_soft, SSE_soft, median). Evaluate each hard method against spending and context_no_salary on their pairwise common support. Do not compare errors from method-specific supports as if fair.
evaluation.comparisons: For each cluster retrieval method compare to spending and context_no_salary on primary support; record equal-region absolute/relative delta and counts of regions improved/tied/worsened.
evaluation.positive_gate: A cluster method has a numerical improvement in this fixed protocol only if its primary equal-region log MAE is strictly lower than BOTH spending and context_no_salary. No significance or generalization claim from a tiny delta. Report coverage and region-level heterogeneity regardless.
evaluation.negative_gate: If no cluster method beats both controls, report added-value claim not confirmed for this task; retain direct/global retrieval and clusters as navigation. Do not retune parameters or replace target/month.
evaluation.no_p_values: No independent-sample significance assumed for related municipalities/overlapping candidate sets; no p-value or causal claim.

quality_assurance: Exact unique ID joins and observed December coverage
Strict same-type other-region candidate constraints and no repeated/self candidate
Salary permutation and alteration of salary X_raw column leave admitted valid support and every selected ID unchanged
Retrieval input contract contains no salary values or annual context6 labels
Recompute all predictions from selected IDs and raw salary
Recompute primary and secondary aggregates from per-query outputs
Deterministic repeated retrieval and artifact comparison
limits: Organization salary excluding small businesses is not residents' income.
The source cohort has conditional territorial admission and selection bias; same administrative type does not certify comparable physical boundaries.
Frozen national labels and spending normalization use full retrospective panel; this is transductive retrieval, not an entirely region-held-out clustering pipeline.
Upstream use of socio-economic data in modeled spending is unknown.
Prior salary diagnostics and examples were already examined; target is not untouched holdout.
Worker and education ratios may share upstream data with wage series; omission of direct salary does not prove source independence.
Negative results do not invalidate useful descriptive profiles, but no ROI, time-saving, functional-type or forecast benefit is inferred.
